parameters.name: PageNumber
parameters.description: The page number of the list. Default value: 1.

parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description: The number of entries per page in a paged query. Maximum value: **50**. Default value: **10**.

parameters.name: RegionId
parameters.description:
The region ID.

You can call the [DescribeRegions](~~36063~~) operation to query the region ID.

parameters.name: ResourceGroupId
parameters.description: The ID of the resource group to which the VBR belongs.

sub_parameters.name: Key
sub_parameters.description:
The tag key of the resource. You must specify at least 1 tag key and can specify at most 20 tag keys. The tag key cannot be an empty string.

A tag key can be up to 128 characters in length. It cannot start with `aliyun` or `acs:`, and cannot contain `http://` or `https://`.
